findings.title: Independent semantic campaign failed
findings.requirement: Independent 1,120+ campaign must have zero material false allows, zero material false refusals and zero metamorphic failures.
findings.impact: Blocks PASS and R19 prospective governance.

findings.title: Dominant veto rejects genuine mixed-domain tax questions
findings.requirement: Ordinary objects remain ALLOW or tax-appropriate CLARIFY when the user asks a Philippine-tax question about them.
findings.impact: Material false refusals on deductible fan purchases, music-channel income, raffles, fun runs, prescriptions, customs duty and similar tax questions.

findings.title: Tax-shaped anchors still create false allows for explicit non-tax meanings
findings.requirement: Explicit non-tax expansions and ordinary non-tax controls must remain NOT_ALLOW.
findings.impact: The boundary still admits non-tax uses of FLD, customs lessons, transfer-pricing game mechanics, title-case false acronym expansions and similar controls.

findings.title: Executor unseen campaign is not independent for the final runtime
findings.requirement: A campaign used to refine final runtime is not an unseen holdout for that runtime.
findings.evidence: Commit b3e879b1 message states runtime refinements were discovered while building and iterating the executor unseen campaign; commit 23f71a39 later records the 726-row unseen evidence.
findings.impact: The 726-row campaign may be useful development coverage, but it cannot support statistical holdout or unseen-governance claims for b3e879b1.

findings.title: Governed attempt registry omits required invocations
findings.requirement: Frozen plan section 9 requires every governed invocation, including pre-fix, development, unseen, focused batches, gates and retries, to be registered.
findings.evidence: CANONICAL_ATTEMPT_REGISTRY.json counts: total=4, domain_campaign=0, focused_suite=0; executor report separately relies on three domain campaigns and 22 focused suites.
findings.impact: The claim that every count derives from the registry is misleading; failed/transient and non-gate evidence is not immutably attempted in the registry.

findings.title: R18 assertion was widened to accept either veto family
findings.requirement: Regression assertions should preserve material reason family and precedence where required.
findings.evidence: tests/phase-10a14-r18-domain-hardening.test.mjs now accepts non_tax_object_veto or non_tax_object_role_veto. It still rejects ALLOW and still requires a veto reason.
findings.impact: Bounded weakening/ambiguity in precedence protection, but not the primary blocker because semantic campaign exposes direct failures.
